No individual bill-of-lading record with B/L number, date and destination was retrievable: importkey.com/countries/india/the-anup-engineering-ltd returned only a paywalled shell ("Join ImportKey to view the import and export data records") with 0 shipment rows visible; volza.com, eximpedia.app, trademo.com returned HTTP 403; importgenius.com returned a JavaScript challenge. domestic_evidence: Screener.in standalone P&L (company filings): "Sales + 0 243 245 279 288 411 550 708 789 672" for Mar 2018–Mar 2026 — FY2026 standalone sales Rs 789 crore, of which ~51.8% (non-export) is domestic supply; consolidated Q Sep 2026 sales Rs 182.40 crore. Domestic customers named on company site include Reliance, Indian Oil Corporation, Hindustan Petroleum, plus third-party appreciation letters from SPX Flow Technologies (India) Pvt Ltd and Samsung Engineering India Pvt Ltd. GSTIN-level turnover band not public in retrieved sources.
note: Legal entity exists and is listed: CIN L29306GJ2017PLC099085 (from company website footer), BSE 542460 / NSE ANUP, demerged from Arvind Ltd in 2018; registered office Odhav Road, Ahmedabad-382415, Gujarat. Declared HS 848120 (valves for oleohydraulic/pneumatic transmission) and industry 'IT и электроника' are both wrong: the company manufactures shell-and-tube heat exchangers, reactors, pressure vessels, columns/towers and industrial centrifuges — process equipment, not electronics/valves. Per project rules this is not a rejection ground: record kept, actual HS should be corrected to the heat-exchanger/pressure-vessel chapter (HS 8419.50 for heat exchange units / 8419.89 as applicable) and industry to industrial process equipment; verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Shipment factuality: export activity is confirmed by disclosed export revenue share (~48.2%, Mar 2026) and a 34-country footprint, but no dated customs/B-L line item could be verified from free sources — the specific B/L numbers, dates and destination countries remain unverified (null). Domestic supply is confirmed by audited revenue and named Indian customers. Revenue: FY2026 standalone Rs 789 crore, consolidated Q Sep 2026 Rs 182.40 crore; export volume in absolute terms not separately published in retrieved sources (null).
